dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: My family was given an order by Lady Vennessa. We are to keep watch here, looking out over the sea for any sign of an oncoming storm.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: For generations, everyone in my family has felt honored to have this duty.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: We see it as our life's purpose to be signal beacons for Mondstadt, ready to spread the message to every corner of Mondstadt at the first sign of a storm.

dialogues.speaker: Vind
dialogues.text: But... That's all in the past, now.
